silhouetteDiagnostics.meaning: Foreground-mask overlap in five fixed views, including visible head silhouettes. This does not measure all 3D depths, material fidelity, historical accuracy or complete weapon correctness.

findingsAndRemainingWork: A round-looking source head was checked geometrically and modeled as a cylindrical form with softened shading, replacing the initial spherical guess.
The two polygon heads retain separate visual orientations and elevations; they are not replaced with a uniform rivet array.
Incorrect relief-border wall normal orientation in the new generator was fixed before final browser review.
Outer arcs, microedges and normal transitions still differ from the source. Those differences remain open for visual review.
Receiver body and complete Aircraft model have not yet been independently rebuilt.
Installation, ammunition flow, weapon animation and complete procedural PBR remain outside this delivered step.
The candidate has more runtime triangles than the source sideplate. No claim of smaller GPU cost or faster rendering is supported.
